steps.en: Install the adapter for your framework
steps.zh: 安装对应框架的适配包

steps.en: Create the form from typed default values, validators and a submit handler
steps.zh: 用带类型的默认值、校验器和提交函数创建表单

steps.en: Infers every field name and type from the default values; tracks value, touched and errors
steps.zh: 从默认值推断每个字段名和类型，记录值、是否碰过、错误

steps.en: Render each field through its render prop and wire it to your own input
steps.zh: 用渲染函数渲染每个字段，接到你自己的输入组件上

steps.en: Runs validators on change, blur or submit; debounces and cancels async checks
steps.zh: 在输入、失焦或提交时跑校验，异步校验自动防抖和取消
在表单元素上触发提交

steps.en: Validates everything, then calls your onSubmit with the typed values only if valid
steps.zh: 全量校验，通过后才把带类型的值交给你的 onSubmit

value.en: No per-input useState, touched flags or error bookkeeping; a typo in a field name is a compile error
value.zh: 不再给每个输入手写 useState、touched 标记和错误状态；字段名写错直接编译报错

sources: docs/philosophy.md (useForm({ defaultValues: defaultPerson }), infer types from runtime defaults, controlled inputs)
